caption_claim: FocalSwap separates ranking gain, opportunity, dependence, focal specificity, and downstream recovery.
core_conclusion: FocalSwap converts behavior-level regimes into a search-centered row, five controlled views, three attribution gates, and a separate downstream recovery probe.

caption_claim: Opportunity, specificity, and deployable gate evidence remain separated across regimes, with local specificity distinguished from broad evidence.
core_conclusion: KuaiSAR and Qilin differ in opportunity surface; Qilin has a low-coverage local taxonomy subset, but neither establishes stable wide-coverage focal-transfer evidence.
statistics: bootstrap CI where available; shuffled-null p95/p99 thresholds

caption_claim: Broad matched buckets stay near placebo; tax>=4 is the only Holm-stable row in the ten-bucket family and is a low-coverage local pocket.
core_conclusion: Qilin broad matched buckets remain near placebo, while only a low-coverage taxonomy bucket survives multiplicity.
statistics: user-cluster bootstrap 95% CI plus Holm/BH adjustment across the ten displayed matched buckets from R179; distinct from the five-rung R213 G4 ladder

caption_claim: Latest-slot intervals cross zero, while the positive all-source C0 margin is control-sensitive on fixed UniSAR rows.
core_conclusion: Latest-slot dependence is not established, while UniSAR's positive all-source C0 neutral-mask margin disappears under the C1 and C2 observed-support donors on the same rows.
statistics: 95% user-cluster bootstrap CIs for the latest-slot intervention, C0, and C1; C2 and paired C0-C2 endpoints use 97.5% CIs
visual_grammar: two-panel forest plot with latest-slot estimates and all-source controls grouped by seed

caption_claim: G1--G3 license focal attribution; recovery is reported separately.
core_conclusion: Focal attribution requires observability, calibrated opportunity, dependence, and matched specificity; downstream recovery is a separate usefulness probe.

caption_claim: The two regimes occupy different attribution and recovery layers under one audit.
core_conclusion: KuaiSAR and Qilin occupy different evidence layers: broad proxy and lexical readouts do not establish a stable wide-coverage focal-transfer signal.
statistics: reported confidence intervals for G3 plus calibrated G2 and recovery deltas

caption_claim: Only a low-coverage Qilin taxonomy bucket separates from its same-subset random reference after Holm correction.
core_conclusion: Broad matched-swap estimates remain close to their references; only the low-coverage Qilin tax>=4 pocket survives Holm correction.
statistics: 95% confidence intervals and Holm-adjusted p-values for the Qilin bucket family
